headline: Saturday, Nov 28. Dry and calm for the Murray welcome; the storm keeps softening.

items: Sat (today) 55/48 cloudy, dry all day, light ESE wind
Sun 61/50 with light rain 40% and S gusts near 25 mph - the windier drizzle day
Mon (Granite start) 60/53, mostly dry, just a 30% sprinkle day and night
Tue Dec 1 and Wed Dec 2 turn sunny, 59-64
Next system arrives Thu Dec 3: rain showers 65%, about 0.8 in across the day
Today hourly: 50F at 5am rising to 57 by mid-afternoon, dry straight through, perfect for the farm drive

sections.lead: Last day of the home-and-heart Moon: Cancer finishes its run tonight, and the day's job is simple - warm welcome, then tidy up.
items: Mars sextile your natal Moon: gentle drive to get hosting chores done before guests arrive
A waning Moon square nudges loose ends - the morning is good for the last small to-dos
Mercury square your natal Mars is easing off, but re-read texts anyway
How to use it: front-load the prep and driving in the morning, host with full warmth at noon, coast into the evening
sections.body: Details: Moon Cancer 27.8 (leaves for Leo late tonight), waning gibbous 82% lit. Mars sextile natal Moon 0.2, Moon square natal Moon 0.8. Neptune R trine natal Venus 0.8, Venus conj natal Moon 1.0. Saturn R trine natal Sun 1.9. Mercury square natal Mars easing 1.9. Sun trine natal Sun 2.2. Jupiter sextile natal Moon 2.7. One-line read: host mode, warmth all day; tidy first, then welcome the Murrays.

items: Zero new construction-dispatch leads, the 20th straight construction-only run
LinkedIn gave a blank capture this run; ZipRecruiter sat on its verification wall again; Indeed showed repeats
Indeed also surfaced a CHP Public Safety Dispatch Supervisor listing - public safety, not construction, so outside the lane
Tracker holds 49 awaiting your Apply / Not-for-me
East Bay dog-attack investigation: the suspect had surrendered a cane corso to Antioch Animal Services weeks ago; staff determined it wasn't one of the two dogs involved (Oaklandside)
The king-tides coastal flood watch continues on the coast through the weekend; Antioch stays inland and dry
Antioch feeds otherwise quiet overnight
0 interview requests and no new mail overnight
Easy win: slow Saturday morning, second pot of coffee
1. 12:00-2:00pm Welcoming the Murrays to the Bay, Ruhstaller Farm, 6686 Sievers Rd, Dixon - it's about 60 minutes each way via CA-160 (tolls), so leave by 11:00
2. DE 2501 in the mail if Friday slipped - post offices run normal Saturday hours today
3. 10am apply run will check the queue as usual (expect quiet)
Rest: 3pm sweep, 5pm site check, 6pm/7pm runs on their own; no iron today (Sunday is)
Tony's and Family calendars are quiet; the Murray welcome is the day's anchor. Have fun out there.
